answer_box: To buy khaprail tiles in bulk, measure the sloped roof surface, count ridge and edge pieces, order from one batch and get a written quote stating unit, inclusions, delivery terms and date. Pak Clay in Lahore quotes bulk orders on WhatsApp and offers a free sample first.

author: Pak Clay Team

faqs.question: How much do bulk khaprail tiles cost?
faqs.answer: The rate depends on profile, finish, quantity, season, transport and included pieces, and may be quoted per piece or per square foot. Ask Pak Clay for a written quote with the unit and the date.

faqs.question: Is it better to buy from a maker or a dealer?
faqs.answer: Each works. A maker can answer questions about the profile, finish and batch directly, while a dealer may stock several brands. Compare quotes only when unit, inclusions and delivery terms match.

faqs.question: How do I keep tile colour consistent on a big roof?
faqs.answer: Order the whole roof in one go, ask for a sample from the batch you will receive, and mix pieces from several pallets while laying. Keep spares from the same batch.

faqs.question: Does Pak Clay publish a minimum order for bulk rates?
faqs.answer: No. We do not publish a minimum quantity or discount online. Ask on WhatsApp with your quantity and we answer in writing.
